## Highlights

A redesigned interface, commit search, and several security fixes.

### New
- **Search**: Ctrl+F searches the loaded history by message, author, hash or ref name; Enter / Shift+Enter step through matches.
- **Repository overview** in the details pane when nothing is selected: branch, upstream status and a summary of uncommitted changes.
- **Ahead/behind counts** on Pull and Push. Force push (with lease) now lives in the menu next to Push.
- **Diffs** show line numbers and a file header with added/removed counts; the raw `diff --git` / `index` lines are hidden.

### Improved
- A branch and its remote copy on the same commit share one lane-coloured pill; extra refs collapse into a "+N" chip.
- Commit subjects no longer collapse behind badges; dates are compact (hover for the full timestamp).
- Lane palette no longer uses red; muted text has more contrast; keyboard focus rings added.
- Sidebar: lane-colour dots, a count on Local Changes, stashes shown as `stash@{n}`, remotes shown by host.
- Changes list: directory/filename split, always-visible Stage / Unstage / Discard buttons, and a "Commit N files" button.
- Tabs show a dot when the repo has uncommitted changes.

### Security and fixes
- Working-tree diffs of untracked files are now restricted to paths inside the repository.
- File paths, commit ids and remote-branch names from the UI are validated more strictly (including an option-injection case in remote checkout).
- Fixed a file-watcher leak when a repository was closed while still opening; tightened the Content Security Policy and IPC payload validation.
- Electron updated to 45.3.2.

### Project
- New user guide and screenshots: https://smistry7.github.io/forklin/
- UI smoke test (`npm run test:e2e`), CI hardening, Dependabot, `SECURITY.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md`.

Install: download the AppImage below, `chmod +x`, and run it. Needs `git` 2.25 or newer.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/smistry7/forklin/compare/v0.2.1...v0.3.0
